# A literal `cache.inputs` in what a plugin writes names inputs the store
# reads -- to complete each one now and to check it again on every later
# build -- so each is a read the plugin makes, held to its grants as gen.lines,
# gen.env and gen.exec are. Unasked, the plugin's own output could name a
# file anywhere on the machine, a variable holding a token, or a process run
# in a directory it chose.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check env/app.sngl
stderr 'may not read \$SNGL_SECRET'
sngl check --allow-env='./pc=SNGL_SECRET' env/app.sngl

! sngl check file/app.sngl
stderr 'may not read /etc/hostname'

! sngl check entry/app.sngl
stderr 'cache.entry is the library''s to declare'

# Inside the import root a file needs nothing.
sngl check inroot/app.sngl

-- env/app.sngl --
import x "w:x"
import "./pc"

const v = x.v
-- env/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="w", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.env(name=\"SNGL_SECRET\")\n\}\n\nconst v = 1\n")
})
-- file/app.sngl --
import x "w:x"
import "./pc"

const v = x.v
-- file/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="w", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.file(path=\"/etc/hostname\")\n\}\n\nconst v = 1\n")
})
-- entry/app.sngl --
import x "w:x"
import "./pc"

const v = x.v
-- entry/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="w", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.entry(producer=\"go.deps\", params=[\"/\", \"x\"])\n\}\n\nconst v = 1\n")
})
-- inroot/app.sngl --
import x "w:x"
import "./pc"

const v = x.v
-- inroot/data.txt --
hi
-- inroot/pc/pc.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

gen.scheme(name="w", @generate(out, importPath) {
    out.write("x.sngl", "import cache \"sngl:x/gen/cache\"\n\ncache.inputs \{\n    cache.file(path=\"data.txt\")\n\}\n\nconst v = 1\n")
})
